systems.system: new generation national ID card system
systems.owner: General Delegation for National Security (DGSN), under a 15-year contract with Augentic
systems.tiers: online pre-enrolment from 17 February 2025, biometric capture from 24 February, issuance from 3 March 2025; two issuance centres in Yaounde and regional headquarters

note: On the start of national identity card issuance; nothing on civil registration.
